brief: Productized AI services pricing that converts. Why hourly is dead, what flat rates actually work, the retainer trap you should avoid.

slots.author: Morgan Vale
slots.headline: Productized AI Pricing That Actually Converts
slots.body: Hourly billing kills margins. Flat-rate productized services are how AI agencies scale without scope creep.

slots.author: Morgan Vale
slots.title: Why Hourly Pricing Is Broken
slots.body: Tracking hours punishes efficiency. The faster you deliver AI value, the less you earn. That’s a broken incentive.

slots.author: Morgan Vale
slots.title: The Flat-Rate Model Explained
slots.body: Scope the deliverable, not the hours. Clients buy outcomes—chatbots, audits, integrations—with a fixed price and clear boundary.

slots.author: Morgan Vale
slots.title: Three Tiers That Actually Sell
slots.body: Starter, Pro, and Enterprise packages let clients self-select. It cuts negotiation time and increases average deal size instantly.

slots.author: Morgan Vale
slots.title: Avoid The Retainer Trap
slots.body: Monthly retainers sound safe until scope balloons. Productized services define the finish line so every engagement stays profitable.

slots.author: Morgan Vale
slots.title: Productize Your AI Stack Now
slots.body: Package one repeatable workflow into a named service. Add a price, a timeline, and a checklist. Then sell it on repeat.

slots.author: Morgan Vale
slots.title: What Conversion Looks Like
slots.body: Clear pricing builds instant trust. Buyers skip the sales call because they already know the cost and exactly what’s included.

slots.author: Morgan Vale
slots.headline: Ready To Ditch Hourly Billing?
slots.body: Comment below and repost this to save the framework. Let’s build productized offers together.
